title: Uncertainty-Aware Compositional Localization and Placement Assessment of Catheters and Tubes in Chest X-Rays
abstract: arXiv:2608.11288v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Assessing catheter and tube placement on chest X-rays is safety-critical yet tedious and error-prone. Current deep learning methods either classify placement globally -- losing track of which device is where -- or segment all devices into a single mask, making per-device assessment impossible when catheters overlap. We introduce UCompCXR, a compositional framework that detects local catheter fragments, associates them into device instances via graph-based clustering, fuses per-fragment tip predictions through precision-weighted Gaussian estimation, and classifies placement per device. On the RANZCR CLiP dataset (30,083 images, 5-fold patient-level CV with bootstrap CIs), UCompCXR detects 26% more devices than a strong multi-task baseline sharing the same MobileNetV3 backbone, with 75% fewer false positives and well-calibrated tip uncertainty (95% coverage = 0.948). translated_title: 不确定性感知的导管与管道在胸部X光片中的组合定位与放置评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11288v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：评估胸部X光片上的导管和管道放置是安全关键但繁琐且易出错的任务。当前深度学习方法要么全局分类放置——丢失了哪个设备在哪里的追踪——要么将所有设备分割成单一掩码，使得当导管重叠时无法进行逐设备评估。我们引入了UCompCXR，一种组合框架，它检测局部导管片段，通过基于图的聚类将它们关联成设备实例，通过精度加权高斯估计融合每个片段的尖端预测，并对每个设备进行分类放置。在RANZCR CLiP数据集（30,083张图像，5折患者级交叉验证，带自举置信区间）上，UCompCXR检测到的设备比共享相同MobileNetV3骨干的强多任务基线多26%，假阳性减少75%，并且尖端不确定性校准良好（95%覆盖率=0.948）。聚合尖端误差上升——但仅因为模型发现了更多设备。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种组合式框架UCompCXR，通过局部片段检测、图聚类关联和精度加权融合，实现了对胸部X光片中导管和管道的逐设备放置评估，显著提高了检测率和校准不确定性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces UCompCXR, a compositional framework that enables per-device placement assessment of catheters and tubes in chest X-rays via local fragment detection, graph-based clustering, and precision-weighted fusion, significantly improving detection rate and calibrated uncertainty.
